node_definition.done_when: a-dispatch-returns-without-its-worker §6's done-when holds. tests/test_dispatch_result_matches_launch.py drives a dispatch with a stub backend in a temporary crew config home, through each path the section names that has returned a refusal beside a live pointer. It covers the handler around the post-launch tree snapshot, imas-ambix-61's post-launch cleanup that refused to remove the run's own worktree, and the survival-check refusal removed at merge 1859c0d19, which stays as a regression guard. For each, the test asserts that the result either names the launched run with ok: true, or leaves no pointer, no worktree for the node, and no worker that record_process_alive reports alive. A refusal that leaves any one of the three fails the test. At the node's base, each mechanism is driven first and the manifest states whether it still returns a refusal beside a pointer, a worktree or a live worker, naming the commit that removed it if it no longer does. A second test passes an unresolvable --member and asserts a refusal with no auto-derived member bound; this verifies existing behaviour and changes no source. A third test covers every ok: false result the reckon crew dispatch command emits, live and --dry-run alike, including a contract-validation refusal on a done-when holding a literal placeholder. It asserts each carries error and detail as non-empty strings, so an absent key fails as a null one does. Any refusal missing them is fixed, in reckon/cli.py (the dry-run verdict and the not-dispatchable branch) or reckon/crew/dispatch.py. The declared negative control is executed and logged under pytest at the base, wherever a refusal is returned beside a live pointer, or else by removing one fix in a scratch tree. The test files importing reckon.crew.dispatch or reckon.cli are run at base and at head with pytest-xdist -n 8, each arm with its own --basetemp under $TMPDIR, and they add no failing id. No real scheduler verb runs. Every log sits under the run directory, headed with revision, tree and literal command, and ends EXIT=. Only reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/cli.py and the new test file change.
